exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean core u, r>=1 fresh point controls with p=2^(-r), F=1+A_r(u-1), and finite adaptive physical core-only restriction tree T, the lifted actual leaf partition obeys Pi_I(F)=p*Pi_I(u) and |Pi_H(F)-p*Pi_H(u)|<=(12+8/ln(2))*Pi_I(F), with all remaining-core entropy and terminal control reserve retained. For proper-core stopping trees with Pi_H(u)<=K*Pi_I(u) and C001-regular core terminals, H(F)<=max(K+12+8/ln(2),C_reg)*I(F). In particular u=chi_[t]*g with t>=1 and regular g on at least one remaining core coordinate admits the proper character-block rule H(F)<=(12+8/ln(2))*I(F), even for g=D_s where core density tends to zero. A universal forward activation surcharge exactly 4 is refuted by the actual proper-core example u=z*D_32, r=16: the certified Pi_H(F)/Pi_I(F)>8193/2048 while Pi_H(u)=0. The iterated r->infinity then s->infinity surcharge limit on u=z*D_s is 4. Version 2 retains every version-1 component unchanged and strengthens the core-only transport: for every arbitrary Boolean controller a=1-2c on a DISJOINT uniform physical cube, p=Pr(a=-1), F=1+c(u-1), and every finite actual core-only stopping tree, Pi_I(F)=p Pi_I(u) and |Pi_H(F)-p Pi_H(u)|<=(4+12/ln(2))Pi_I(F), with 4+12/ln(2)<22. The controller spectral entropy cancels linearly across the core bias martingale, while all controller entropy remains in actual activated terminals. Their influence reserve is p E I(u_leaf)+Pr(u=-1)I(a). If the specified proper core partition has Pi_H(u)<=K Pi_I(u) and actual activated leaves have H<=L I, then H(F)<=max(K+4+12/ln(2),L)I(F). Ordinary controller FEI K_a and uniform core-leaf FEI K_l suffice for L=max(K_a+6,K_l), by the independently reconstructed A028 scalar correction. No universal paid core partition, arbitrary-controller certificate, or shared-support extension is asserted. Version 3 retains every previous component and adds interleaved point-control transport. For every Boolean core u, r>=1 fresh point controls p=2^(-r), F=1+A_r(u-1), and finite actual physical restriction tree T interleaving core and control queries, prune only queries after a failing control. Condition the original INPUT on all controls passing and delete deterministic control queries to obtain an actual core tree U. Active leaf l has projected weight v_l=w_l*p_l/p, where p_l=2^(-remaining controls). Q_core=p*Pi_I(u;U). Set Q_core_live to core influence queried before controls are exhausted, Q_control to queried control influence, and E=Pi_H(F;T)-p*Pi_H(u;U). Then -(4+12/ln2)Q_core_live<=E<=(4+12/ln2)Q_core_live+C0 Q_control, C0=2+2/ln2+1/(sqrt(e)ln2)<6, with a single signed root-to-terminal activation correction and all actual terminal entropies retained. If U is proper and Pi_H(u;U)<=K Pi_I(u;U), K>=0, and every actual active terminal has H<=L I, L>=0, then H(F)<=max(K+4+12/ln2,C0,L)I(F). No universal paid partition or shared-support extension is asserted.
